title: Expert Supervision Exception
description: Product manufacturer not liable if product meant for use under expert supervision with adequate warnings

content.general_rule: Product manufacturer liable for failure to provide adequate warnings or instructions
content.exception: Product manufacturer not liable if product meant for use under expert supervision with adequate warnings
conditions: product was legally meant to be used or dispensed only by or under the supervision of an expert or a class of experts
product manufacturer had employed reasonable means to give the warnings or instructions for usage of such product to such expert or class of experts
